Find the code for the word “strike out”?
questions.nameText:
Directions : Read the following information carefully and answer the questions given beside. 
“action packed night concert” is coded as “jio nul meb fot”
 
“star night out media” is coded as “ops hfa meb gul”
 
“media action report drama” is coded as “nul vis hfa dum”
 
 
“star strike media concert” is coded as “hfa gul fot sam”
 
Find the code for the word “strike out”?

options.name: ops jio
ops sam
gul fot
gul sam

questions.solution:
Correct Option: B

Strike out is coded as sam ops.

 

Hence option B is correct.

 

Common Explanation:

 

“action packed night concert” is coded as “jio nul meb fot” --- (1)

 

“star night out media” is coded as “ops hfa meb gul”-------------- (2)

 

“media action report drama” is coded as “nul vis hfa dum”--------(3)

 

“star strike media concert” is coded as “hfa gul fot sam”------------(4)

 

From (1) and (2) we get:

 

night – meb ----- (5)

 

From (2) and (3), we get:

 

media – hfa ------ (6)

 

From (2), (4) and (6), we get:

 

star – gul ---- (7)

 

From (2), (5), (6) and (7), we get:

 

out – ops ----- (8)

 

From (1) and (3), we get:

 

action – nul --- (9)

 

From (1), (4), (5) and (9), we get:

 

concert – fot ----- (10)

 

From (1), (4), (5), (9) and (10), we get:

 

packed – jio ------ (11)

 

From (4), (6), (7) and (10), we get:

 

strike – sam ---- (12)

 

From (3), (6) and (9), we get:

 

 

drama report – vis dum (not necessarily in same order) ----- (13)

“action packed night concert” is coded as “jio nul meb fot”
 
“star night out media” is coded as “ops hfa meb gul”
 
“media action report drama” is coded as “nul vis hfa dum”
 
 
“star strike media concert” is coded as “hfa gul fot sam”
Which of the following codes could be a possible code for "packed goods"?

options.name: vis jio
nul jio
gul tue
jio anw

questions.solution:
Correct Option: D

Code for Packed is jio and goods is a newly introduced word, so its code must be unique.

 

As per the given options, only option D provide jio matched with a new word "anw".

 

Thus, the possible code for "packed goods" could be jio anw.

 

 

Hence option D is correct.
